metadata.description: Skills for AI agents to the open Agent Skills standard.

plugins.name: commit
plugins.description: Commits changes in a git repository in small, checked steps on the right branch, for any language or toolchain. Finds the project's own checks (format, lint, types, tests, lock files) and runs them before every commit, decides whether a change belongs on the current branch or on a new one, keeps secrets and ignored files out, and writes the message from the actual diff. Pushing, pull requests and merging wait for the user's word. Use this skill whenever the user asks to commit, to save the work in git, to split work into commits or to put a change on a branch, and whenever the project's rules say to commit after each step. Answers in the user's language.

plugins.name: asset-analysis
plugins.description: Writes a structured analysis of a single security from current price, fundamental and news data, with an assessment for the short, medium and long term. Use this skill whenever an ISIN, a ticker or a security's name comes up, or when someone asks about a stock, an ETF, a cryptocurrency, a price target, quarterly figures, analyst opinions, a valuation or a comparison of several securities, also when they only ask in passing what is going on with a title and the word analysis never falls. Not for a dividend calendar or a portfolio's distributions per month. Answers in the user's language.

plugins.name: dividend-calendar
plugins.description: Builds a dividend calendar for a portfolio, for the current or a coming year, from each position's dividend history and with fixed, traceable calculation rules. Past months show what was paid, coming months the forecast, and every gap in the data is named. Use this skill whenever someone asks for a dividend calendar, for distributions per month, for a year's dividend income, or when each position pays, also when they only hand over a list of holdings with share counts. Answers in the user's language.

plugins.name: prepare-for-compaction
plugins.description: Prepares a working session for a context compaction or a new session. Moves what only the conversation holds into the agent's persistent memory: the user's decisions in their own words, corrections, permissions and how far they reach, traps of the environment and the exact state of the work. Measures every fact before writing it down, refreshes the memories the session touched, tidies what the new state replaces and leaves the project's files alone. Use this skill whenever the user asks to prepare for a compact, a compaction, a context reset or a handover to the next session, also in short forms such as 'prepare compact' or 'auf compact vorbereiten'. Answers in the user's language.

plugins.name: development
plugins.description: Every development skill in one plugin. Skills for working in a repository with an agent, in any language. They follow the project's own rules and checks, and they leave pushing, merging and releasing to you.

plugins.name: development-git
plugins.description: Every git skill of development in one plugin. Skills for git in any project: commits in small, checked steps on the branch a change belongs to. Pushing, merging and releasing stay with you.

plugins.name: finance
plugins.description: Every finance skill in one plugin, with the MCP server benethos-yahoo-finance-mcp for the data. Skills for securities and portfolios. They calculate from current market data and name every gap in it. They give no recommendation and no investment, tax or legal advice.

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Every workflow skill in one plugin. Skills for long working sessions with an agent. They keep decisions, permissions and the state of the work safe across a context compaction and into the next session. They change no file of the project.

plugins.name: benethos-yahoo-finance-mcp
plugins.description: Market data from Yahoo Finance as an MCP server, for the finance skills. Read-only, no account and no API key. Needs uv.
